processing: Native window captures without shadows; narrow solid-color padding preserves the 16:10 canvas without distorting the app. Personal file paths in logs are covered by explicit privacy masks.

overview.description: Current sandboxed Store inventory filtered to three disposable real user agents: running, loaded and disabled/unloaded.

detail.description: Native plist editor for the disposable cleanup user agent, showing its command and daily schedule. No change was saved during capture.

login-items.description: Real registered login helper with Store-specific lifecycle restrictions and an eligible Disable action. The vendor service was not changed.

logs.description: Actual stdout written by launchd's disposable preview service and read by the sandboxed Store app through its LaunchAgents exception.
